title: Tally Charts & Pictographs

scenes.t: The class did a survey: which sea creature do you like best? We collect data and record it.
A tally chart uses marks. One mark for each vote. The fifth mark crosses the four: that group is 5. Then start again.
To read a tally, count in fives and then add the ones. Five plus three more is 8.
A pictograph shows data with pictures. The KEY tells what one picture stands for, for example 🐠 = 2 pupils.
If 🐠 = 2 pupils and there are 4 pictures, that is 4 × 2 = 8 pupils. Half a picture means 1 pupil.
We can answer questions from data: which is the most popular? how many more chose seahorse than stingray? 8 − 3 = 5.

items.a: Asking people questions to collect data.
Tells what one picture stands for.
